_note: Inputs for model/national_scenarios.py. Every other factor comes from model/params.json. ASSUMPTION marks a declared choice, not a sourced value.

qc_thresholds.source: Mirror of national_supply.py constants BG_MAX_DB and THR_MAX_DB, which the quality check uses (shown for reference; not read from here). A region-season is classified only if one desert-background date has HV at or below -21 dB (sand is about -23 to -27 dB; brighter backgrounds signal interference or non-sand ground) and its threshold is at most 6 dB above the desert median

southwest_admin.source: Shield regions where Sentinel-2 greenness is largely rain-fed, spate or shallow-alluvial farming and the radar threshold is unreliable on non-sand ground; reported on a separate line

monte_carlo.source: Triangular(low, central, high) on each params.json factor; irrigation depths share one quantile, lift one quantile across regions, other factors independent

coverage_factor.source: Share of WorldCover 2021 cropland + tree area inside the 60 processed boxes (data/national/regions.json). Documentation only: no scenario scales by it

mewa_fodder_halt_regions.source: MEWA news item 'saudi-stopping-perennial-fodder-cultivation', 7 Jumada I 1448 AH: perennial fodder stops from 16 Nov 2026 in the sedimentary-shelf regions Al-Jouf, Riyadh, Hail, Eastern Province, Qassim and Tabuk; licensed seasonal fodder (Egyptian clover, Italian and annual ryegrass) allowed

fodder_compliance.source: ASSUMPTION: share of each in-scope field's change that happens

mewa_water_per_ha.source: Press reports of MEWA figures (Arab News, 28 Jan 2026; Okaz 2026); cross-check only, not used in the calculation

pivot_retrofit.source: Amosson et al. 2011, Economics of Irrigation Systems, Texas AgriLife Extension B-6113, Table 1 (US systems: LESA 88%, LEPA 95%; MESA 25 psi, LESA/LEPA 15 psi). The baseline 0.80 is kept equal to the model's central pivot efficiency (Table 1 gives 78% for MESA). No Saudi values found

rebound_share.source: Share of water freed by an efficiency upgrade that is used to irrigate more land when abstraction is not capped (Grafton et al. 2018, Science 361:748; Ward & Pulido-Velazquez 2008, PNAS 105:18215)

cement_plants_file.source: Yamama Cement sector statistics, company-level 2024 cement sales (local + export), 51.15 Mt in total; companies with several plants split by plant capacity (SPCC clinker capacities from the company website; Najran Cement 4.1 + 2.0 Mt). Yamama's active Al-Kharj plant replaces the closed Al-Manakh site; Umm Al-Qura added

cement_dosage_share.source: Char as a share of cement mass, applied to each plant's whole output (a technical ceiling, not likely uptake). Saudi date-palm frond char: no effect at 0.25%, up to +29% strength at 0.75-1.5% (Khan et al. 2022); 1-2% recommended (Gupta et al. 2018; Kua et al. 2019); typical 0.5-5% (Weber et al. 2026); losses usually beyond 2-5% (Hylton et al. 2024). The <2.5% optimum of Zhao et al. 2024 (Biochar 6:21) is not relied on: the co-publisher lists it as retracted while Crossref shows only a correction

cement_eligible_feeds.source: Low-ash chars only: litter and manure chars fall below VM0044 v1.2's 50% carbon requirement for non-soil uses and have the thinnest evidence in cementitious materials

max_char_haul_km.source: ASSUMPTION: farthest char is trucked to a cement or concrete outlet

soil_dose_t_per_ha.source: ASSUMPTION: annual char dose on radar-active fields within the return radius, cautious because chars are alkaline and Saudi farm soils are alkaline and salt-prone; manure and litter chars (high ash, salts) at half the dose. To be replaced by Saudi agronomic limits

min_outlet_share.source: ASSUMPTION: a plant is built only if at least 80% of its char has an outlet (cement allowance or farmland within reach), mirroring the model's 80% minimum feed load

avoided_cement_tco2_per_t_char.source: If a tonne of char replaces a tonne of cement: KAPSARC 2025 (Odeh & Belaid) modelled 0.60-0.66 t CO2/t cement (direct); Climate TRACE v6 national total over USGS output about 0.74; Yamama sustainability reports 0.66-0.90. An emission reduction, never a removal; with about 45 Mt of clinker in stock at end-2024, replaced cement may not cut clinker output at once

haul_radius_km.source: Sensitivity around the 100 km assumption in model/national_siting.py
